# Tembera Cargo

> Tembera Cargo helps people send, track, and receive cargo across Rwanda.

Use the official website for current service details and shipment status. Tracking
results are private to the person with the shipment's tracking code.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://cargo.tembera.nyxarith.com/): Overview and access to cargo services.
- [Track cargo](https://cargo.tembera.nyxarith.com/track): Enter a tracking code to check a shipment.
- [Receive cargo](https://cargo.tembera.nyxarith.com/receive): Check incoming cargo with a tracking code.

## Official site

- https://cargo.tembera.nyxarith.com/
